Agent Name: WebSurfer
Step Number: 4
Reason for Mistake: The WebSurfer agent failed to execute the Planner's specific instruction to visit the Wikipedia page for "In My Skin" (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/In_My_Skin_(film)). Instead, in Step 4, the agent repeatedly re-opened the Wikipedia page for "Passer l'hiver" multiple times without ever navigating to the second film's page or retrieving its production country details as requested. This lack of progress on the second film prevented the gathering of the required two-source confirmation for both movies, leaving the task incomplete.
